simple.meaning: שַׂגִּיא (saggîyʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “(superlatively) mighty.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שַׂגִּיא (H7689) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 36:26, with occurrences in Job.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׂגִּיא (H7689) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שַׂגִּיא (H7689) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שַׂגִּיא (saggîyʼ) / H7689 is traced through Job 36:26, Job 37:23 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
